methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: This article will examine the prominent features of an ISO management system, discuss the anticipated changes and present the expected effects of the revisions on implementing organizations.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Descriptive overview of the ISO 50001 energy management standard and its Annex SL high-level-structure revisions. Energy performance measurement is referenced only generically as the management system's monitoring/measuring 'check' function; no EnPI or EnB measurement model is presented, proposed, evaluated, or characterised (no normalisation variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach). Framework/standard content without EnPI/EnB measurement-model content is ineligible under the v2.3 threshold.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The ISO 50001 Energy Management Standard: What is it and how is it changing?

stage1.notes: 2014 explainer article on ISO 50001 and the harmonised Annex SL high-level structure (PDCA, leadership, risk, performance evaluation). Mentions DOE Superior Energy Performance certification. No EnPI/EnB model and no industrial sector application; ineligible, so Stage 2/3 null and level_3b not applicable.
